countermeasures.name: Process Analysis
countermeasures.rationale: Detect LSASS memory access patterns by enumerating processes that read/write LSASS handles.

countermeasures.name: Local File Permissions
countermeasures.rationale: Restrict LSASS memory read access via Protected Process Light and LSA Protection (RunAsPPL).

countermeasures.name: File Access Pattern Analysis
countermeasures.rationale: Detect bulk reads of user document trees or sensitive directories prior to staging/exfil.

countermeasures.name: Local File Permissions
countermeasures.rationale: Least-privilege ACLs on sensitive data limit which compromised users/processes can collect it.

countermeasures.name: Connection Attempt Analysis
countermeasures.rationale: Detect ICMP/SMB/AD enumeration sweeps used to map reachable hosts post-compromise.

countermeasures.name: Network Isolation
countermeasures.rationale: Microsegmentation prevents successful enumeration responses across trust boundaries.

countermeasures.name: Network Traffic Analysis
countermeasures.rationale: Detect anomalous inbound RDP (TCP/3389) by source IP geolocation, session duration, and brute-force precursors.

countermeasures.name: Network Isolation
countermeasures.rationale: Restrict RDP to jumphosts only; block TCP/3389 at the network edge so externally-sourced brute force never reaches a workstation.

countermeasures.name: Multi-factor Authentication
countermeasures.rationale: Require MFA on every RDP session via Conditional Access / Duo / NPS RADIUS so credential-stuffing alone can't establish interactive logon.

countermeasures.name: File Encryption
countermeasures.rationale: Enforce BitLocker-to-Go on removable media so off-platform reads require the recovery agent.

countermeasures.name: File Analysis
countermeasures.rationale: Audit recentdocs / shellbags / LNK trails for IP-class file access from removable volumes.

countermeasures.name: Executable Allowlisting
countermeasures.rationale: Block execution of unsigned or unknown binaries so packed/obfuscated payloads cannot run on protected hosts.

countermeasures.name: Static Analysis
countermeasures.rationale: Use entropy, packer signatures, and string analysis on suspicious binaries to surface obfuscation prior to execution.

countermeasures.name: Process Spawn Analysis
countermeasures.rationale: Detect whoami, query user, and quser executions chained with other discovery commands.

countermeasures.name: Share Access Pattern Analysis
countermeasures.rationale: Detect anomalous SMB enumeration or bulk reads from file shares by single hosts/accounts.

countermeasures.name: Network Isolation
countermeasures.rationale: Segment file-share access by role/department so a compromised host cannot enumerate enterprise-wide shares.

countermeasures.name: Network Traffic Filtering
countermeasures.rationale: Egress filtering and DLP on the C2 channel cap exfil volume even when the channel itself is permitted.

countermeasures.name: Network Traffic Analysis
countermeasures.rationale: Detect long-lived, high-volume outbound flows mismatched to the protocol's expected profile.

countermeasures.name: Network Isolation
countermeasures.rationale: Microsegmentation prevents a compromised host from sweeping unrelated subnets.

countermeasures.name: Connection Attempt Analysis
countermeasures.rationale: Flag hosts initiating connections to many internal ports/IPs in a short window — classic scan signature.

countermeasures.name: I/O Port Restriction
countermeasures.rationale: Block USB mass-storage class device drivers via Group Policy / MDM allow-list — only signed enterprise devices mount.

countermeasures.name: File Carving
countermeasures.rationale: Audit USBSTOR registry + setupapi.dev.log for newly-enumerated removable devices on workstations handling IP class data.

countermeasures.name: Scheduled Job Analysis
countermeasures.rationale: Enumerate Task Scheduler XML in C:\Windows\System32\Tasks and registry TaskCache to surface adversary-created tasks.

countermeasures.name: Process Spawn Analysis
countermeasures.rationale: Watch for processes spawned by svchost.exe hosting Schedule service to correlate task launches with payload execution.

countermeasures.name: Process Segment Execution Prevention
countermeasures.rationale: DEP/NX prevents execution from data segments, blocking shellcode injection into RW memory regions.

countermeasures.name: Memory Boundary Tracking
countermeasures.rationale: Track RWX allocations and remote memory writes (VirtualAllocEx + WriteProcessMemory) to flag classic injection patterns.

countermeasures.name: Process Code Segment Verification
countermeasures.rationale: Compare in-memory code pages against on-disk image to detect hollowed or patched processes.

countermeasures.name: Process Code Segment Verification
countermeasures.rationale: Detect injected hooks (SetWindowsHookEx, GetAsyncKeyState polling) by comparing in-memory code to disk image.

countermeasures.name: Process Analysis
countermeasures.rationale: Inspect processes loading raw input or hook-related modules outside expected accessibility/input-method contexts.

countermeasures.name: Script Block Logging
countermeasures.rationale: Capture deobfuscated PowerShell script blocks via EventID 4104 to surface malicious payloads even when wrapped in encoded commands.

countermeasures.name: Constrained Language Mode
countermeasures.rationale: Limit PowerShell to a safe subset of language features so adversary tradecraft (Add-Type, reflection, COM) fails to execute on hardened endpoints.

countermeasures.name: Process Analysis
countermeasures.rationale: Inspect powershell.exe / pwsh.exe parent-child relationships and module loads to detect anomalous interpreter use.

T1059.003.attack_name: Command and Scripting Interpreter: Windows Command Shell

countermeasures.name: Process Spawn Analysis
countermeasures.rationale: Detect cmd.exe spawned by Office, browser, or service processes — a strong signal of living-off-the-land execution.

countermeasures.name: Executable Allowlisting
countermeasures.rationale: Restrict cmd.exe execution to authorized administrative contexts via WDAC/AppLocker policies.

countermeasures.name: File Carving
countermeasures.rationale: Recover deleted artifacts from MFT $LogFile + USN journal + slack space to reconstruct attacker activity post-cleanup.

countermeasures.name: File Access Auditing
countermeasures.rationale: Sysmon EventID 23 / 26 surfaces file-delete events with parent-process attribution; ship to SIEM for retroactive correlation.

countermeasures.name: Network Traffic Analysis
countermeasures.rationale: JA3/JA4 fingerprinting + protocol-anomaly detection surfaces C2 channels masquerading as legitimate HTTPS / DNS / SMB.

countermeasures.name: Network Traffic Analysis
countermeasures.rationale: Inspect HTTP/HTTPS metadata for beacon timing, JA3 anomalies, and payload size patterns indicative of C2.

countermeasures.name: DNS Allowlisting
countermeasures.rationale: Restrict DNS resolution to approved domains so newly registered or DGA-generated C2 hosts fail to resolve.

countermeasures.name: File Analysis
countermeasures.rationale: Alert on unusual aggregation patterns (many small docs → single archive in %TEMP% / staging dir) preceding outbound transfer.

countermeasures.name: File Hashing
countermeasures.rationale: Track archive creation events and hash-compare against subsequent egress payloads to confirm staging→exfil chain.

countermeasures.name: Authentication Event Thresholding
countermeasures.rationale: Flag impossible-travel, off-hours, and high-volume logon events tied to legitimate accounts.

countermeasures.name: Multi-factor Authentication
countermeasures.rationale: Require a second factor so stolen credentials alone are insufficient for account access.

countermeasures.name: Process Spawn Analysis
countermeasures.rationale: Detect rapid sequential invocation of systeminfo, wmic, hostname, ver — a low-priority but suggestive recon pattern.

countermeasures.name: File Access Pattern Analysis
countermeasures.rationale: Flag processes that recursively enumerate user/document directories — a precursor to staging or exfil.

countermeasures.name: Process Spawn Analysis
countermeasures.rationale: Detect chained execution of dir, tree, forfiles, and Get-ChildItem from non-interactive processes.

countermeasures.name: Network Traffic Filtering
countermeasures.rationale: Egress filtering blocks outbound retrievals to attacker-controlled hosts and unsanctioned ports.

countermeasures.name: File Hash Reputation Analysis
countermeasures.rationale: Hash newly-arrived binaries against reputation feeds to flag known-bad payloads on ingress.

countermeasures.name: Authentication Event Thresholding
countermeasures.rationale: Lock or alert on accounts exceeding failed-logon thresholds within short windows.

countermeasures.name: Multi-factor Authentication
countermeasures.rationale: MFA defeats password-only brute force by requiring possession-based confirmation.

countermeasures.name: Process Spawn Analysis
countermeasures.rationale: Detect non-interactive processes invoking GDI/screen-capture APIs (BitBlt, PrintWindow) outside expected tooling.

countermeasures.name: Process Analysis
countermeasures.rationale: Identify processes loading user32/gdi32 graphics-capture functions in headless or service contexts.

countermeasures.name: Domain Account Monitoring
countermeasures.rationale: Alert on Outlook PST exports, mass-download via EWS, or unusual mailbox folder syncs from foreign IPs.

countermeasures.name: Multi-factor Authentication
countermeasures.rationale: Require MFA on every mailbox sign-in including legacy IMAP / EWS so single-factor takeover doesn't unlock the inbox.

countermeasures.name: Process Code Segment Verification
countermeasures.rationale: Detect processes hooking OpenClipboard/GetClipboardData via injected code or unexpected module patches.

countermeasures.name: Network Isolation
countermeasures.rationale: Place external remote services behind a VPN concentrator or zero-trust broker; no service exposes a credential prompt directly to the internet.

countermeasures.name: Inbound Authentication Analysis
countermeasures.rationale: Alert on auth attempts from unfamiliar geolocations, impossible-travel sequences, or ASN-reputation hits to externally-reachable services.

countermeasures.name: Process Code Segment Verification
countermeasures.rationale: Detect DLL injection or COM hooks into chrome.exe / msedge.exe that intercept session cookies post-auth.

countermeasures.name: File Access Auditing
countermeasures.rationale: Sysmon FileCreateStreamHash on browser History/Bookmarks SQLite databases catches reads by non-browser processes.

countermeasures.name: Executable Allowlisting
countermeasures.rationale: WDAC/AppLocker rules that block known LOLBins (rundll32, regsvr32, mshta) when invoked outside expected contexts.

countermeasures.name: Process Spawn Analysis
countermeasures.rationale: Detect signed system binaries proxying execution via unusual command lines or parent processes.

countermeasures.name: File Backup
countermeasures.rationale: Immutable / air-gapped backups with object-lock policy ensure destruction events are reversible without paying ransom.

countermeasures.name: File Analysis
countermeasures.rationale: Detect mass file-overwrite patterns (high entropy writes to many extensions in a short window) as ransomware / wiper precursor.

countermeasures.name: File Access Pattern Analysis
countermeasures.rationale: Detect mass-rename, mass-rewrite, and high-entropy write bursts characteristic of ransomware encryption.

countermeasures.name: Restore File
countermeasures.rationale: Recover encrypted data from immutable, offline, or versioned backups to neutralize ransom leverage.

countermeasures.name: Local File Permissions
countermeasures.rationale: Restrict write access to critical data shares so a single compromised account cannot encrypt enterprise files.

T1543.003.attack_name: Create or Modify System Process: Windows Service

countermeasures.name: Service Binary Verification
countermeasures.rationale: Verify service ImagePath binaries against known-good hashes / signatures to detect replaced or planted service executables.

countermeasures.name: Process Spawn Analysis
countermeasures.rationale: Detect new services spawned by services.exe with abnormal command lines or unsigned binaries.

countermeasures.name: Registry Modification Analysis
countermeasures.rationale: Audit changes to HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services to surface adversary service creation or hijack.

countermeasures.name: Executable Allowlisting
countermeasures.rationale: Block unsigned binaries from auto-executing at logon even when the registry pointer is hijacked.

countermeasures.name: File Analysis

countermeasures.name: Executable Allowlisting

countermeasures.name: Data Loss Prevention
